headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Hayward ProLogic/AquaPlus pool controllers via RS-485 WiFi serial bridge. Requires the Python sidecar service — see sidecar/install.sh.
footerDisplay: See the [README](https://github.com/homebridge-fun/homebridge-prologic) for wiring and setup instructions.

sidecarHost.title: Sidecar Host
sidecarHost.description: Host where the Python sidecar service is running (usually localhost on the same Pi).

sidecarPort.title: Sidecar Port
sidecarPort.description: Port for the Python sidecar REST API.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll the sidecar for state updates.

backend.title: Sidecar Backend
backend.description: Which navigation backend the sidecar should use. Changing this restarts the sidecar to apply.

aquaconnectHost.title: AquaConnect Host
aquaconnectHost.description: IP of the AquaConnect web box (used when backend = aquaconnect).

rs485Host.title: RS-485 Bridge Host
rs485Host.description: IP of the USR-W610 WiFi serial bridge (used when backend = rs485).

rs485Port.title: RS-485 Bridge Port
rs485Port.description: TCP port of the USR-W610 serial bridge (used when backend = rs485).

circuits.title: Circuit switches to expose
circuits.description: Which circuits to expose as HomeKit switches. AUX_2 and VALVE_3 are hidden by default (unused on this system).

activeBodies.title: Active pool bodies
activeBodies.description: Which bodies your panel is configured for. Controls the POOL/SPA mode-selection cycle and which heater setpoints are active. This system: pool + spa only (no spillover).

enableActiveHeaterThermostat.title: Active Heat Thermostat (mode-following)
enableActiveHeaterThermostat.description: Expose the mode-following thermostat (Accessory A) that mirrors whichever heater setpoint is active for the current valve mode. Name shows 'Heat — Pool' or 'Heat — Spa'.

enablePoolHeaterThermostat.title: Pool Heat Thermostat (fixed)
enablePoolHeaterThermostat.description: Expose a dedicated Pool Heat thermostat (Accessory B) always showing the pool setpoint regardless of current mode.

enableSpaHeaterThermostat.title: Spa Heat Thermostat (fixed)
enableSpaHeaterThermostat.description: Expose a dedicated Spa Heat thermostat (Accessory C) always showing the spa setpoint regardless of current mode.

enableTemperatureSensors.title: Temperature Sensors
enableTemperatureSensors.description: Expose read-only air and pool temperature sensors.

enableSpaModeSwitch.title: Spa Mode Switch
enableSpaModeSwitch.description: Expose a single 'Spa' switch: On = spa mode, Off = pool mode. Replaces the separate Pool and Spa circuit switches.

enableChlorinatorFan.title: Chlorinator Fan
enableChlorinatorFan.description: Expose pool chlorinator output % as a Fan accessory (speed ring = output %). Read/write via Settings menu navigation.

enablePumpSpeedFan.title: Pump Speed Fan
enablePumpSpeedFan.description: Expose VSP pump slot-4 speed % as a Fan accessory (speed ring = slot 4 %). Read/write via Settings menu navigation.
